ai_summary: AAVAS Financers Limited announced the allotment of 1,540 new equity shares on October 07, 2026, due to the exercise of Employee Stock Options (ESOPs) under its PSOP-2023 scheme. This routine issuance marginally increases the paid-up equity capital and outstanding shares, resulting in a negligible dilution for existing shareholders (approximately 0.0019%) with no material red flags.
